---
title: "Create a scan"
description: "Initialize capture from your backend."
---

[Create a scan](/external/api/create-scan) with a venue ID and a credential scoped to `scans:create` and `scans:update`. The response includes the scan ID and its SDK initialization data:

```json
{
  "id": "124854268324842880",
  "capture": {
    "token": "<capture token>",
    "expires_at": "2026-09-09T14:10:00Z",
    "configuration": "<encoded configuration>"
  }
}
```

Save `id` with your application record and pass `capture.token` and `capture.configuration` to [`createCapture`](/external/web). Capture requests go directly to Bouncr.


## Country and document selection

Supply `country` and `document_type` when creating the scan if your application already has them. Otherwise, the SDK provides the available choices during initialization. The venue’s document policy determines which combinations are accepted.

## Resume capture

[Create a capture token](/external/api/create-token) for the existing scan and initialize the SDK with the response. Accepted captures are restored. See [Resume capture](/external/resume).

## Retrieve the result

[Retrieve the scan](/external/api/get-scan) with `scans:read` to receive progress and available verification results in the same response.
